_doc: OID mini trigger engine config. Plain math on files the mini already writes; never calls RH/FA/UW, never trades. Edits are read every run.

seat_exit_lines._doc: Optional per-seat underlying exit lines (5-min close). Rose/Hal add these when a seat opens. side=below means exit on a close under price.

nvda_drivers._doc: NVDA peer-driver watch: fires when a peer moves >= move_pct from prior close (bands at each multiple) or >= move15_pct over the last 3 closed 5-min bars. per_peer overrides by beta. Tuned 2026-10-16 after the parallel day: AMD/MU at 1% fired 7 move15 pings vs 1 LLM peer ping. prev_close falls back to market-data/latest/rh-quotes.json (mini SIP quotes carry none).

vol_surge._doc: Fast vol_surge loop (2026-10-18; launchd com.oid.desk.volsurge runs oid_triggers.py --vol-surge-loop every interval_s in RTH). Fires when rolling 1-min SIP print volume >= min_rvol_1m x the same-minute 20-session norm AND >= a share floor (per_symbol_min_shares_60s, else the name's median 1-min norm clamped to [min_shares_floor_low, min_shares_60s]) AND price crosses a level within ref_lookback_s (FA call/put wall + gamma flip if FA levels <= levels_max_age_min old, seat_exit_lines, day high/low as of 5 min ago) by >= break_buffer_bps. Skips first skip_open_min minutes, half days, stream/print lag > max_lag_s. Once per symbol/level/PT day. live=false => DRY-RUN (events.jsonl only, never POSTs) regardless of global mode; set live=true to POST (still needs OID_TRIGGERS_MODE=live). Hot-reloaded, no restart needed.
vol_surge._notify_doc: 2026-10-18 ladder dry run: notify_dry=true POSTs DRY-RUN vol_surge events to the wake webhook (payload dry_run=true, tag=ladder-dryrun, trade_action=none; ticker/direction/rvol/price/time_pt) so Rose pulls the RH book read-only. Max notify_max_per_day posts per PT day, one per ticker per notify_dedupe_min minutes. Does not change live/trading behaviour. Turn off: notify_dry=false (hot-reloaded, no restart). Log: ~/oid-desk/state/triggers/notify.jsonl.

news_surge._doc: 2026-10-18 v0.5.0 (SCHEMAS.md v1 §3). LOG-ONLY sibling of vol_surge in the same 2 s loop: no level cross. Gate A rvol_1m>=min_rvol_1m AND shares_60s>=floor; gate B pace_rvol_10s>=min_pace_rvol_10s AND shares_10s>=floor/4 (floor = vol_surge's). Re-arm: >=rearm_min since last fire AND rvol_1m<rearm_rvol_below for rearm_below_s straight. Never POSTs to the webhook. Rows -> ~/oid-data/archive/surges (+ state/news-surge-events.jsonl). enabled=false turns it off (hot-reloaded).

archive._doc: surges archive table (both engines). Inert unless ~/oid-data exists. enabled=false stops writes (hot-reloaded).
